notes: Hoops Story Mode is now a real season at half length: 20 teams in two conferences, 41 games, a mid-season Cup, All-Star Weekend with a 3-Point Contest, a Play-In, playoffs (best of 3, then best of 5 for the conference finals and Finals) and end-of-season awards. Sim a game, a week, or straight to All-Star or the playoffs. Your old career carries over. Racer: road dust off the tyres and darker contact shadows.
